info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Create Careers Applications Offer-v4-spec
info.description: The Careers Applications Offer Management API allows organizations to efficiently manage job application offers through a seamless batch insertion process. This API is primarily focused on enabling HR and recruiting teams to programmatically submit multiple job offers at once, enhancing operational efficiency. Developers can integrate this API into their recruiting software or systems to streamline the hiring process and improve candidate engagement. Use cases include bulk offer management during recruitment campaigns or seasonal hiring events.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new offer for an application. It requires the necessary details to be provided in the request body, and upon successful execution, it returns the created offer details.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary information to create a new offer application. The request must be formatted in JSON and must adhere to the defined schema.
